chunks: In the year two hundred and seventy-nine, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-ʿAbdī, from Ḍawʾ ibn ʿAlī al-ʿIjlī, from a man from the people of Fāris whom he named,
that Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام showed him to him.

key_terms.أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ: Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام, the Imam referred to in the report
key_terms.أَهْلِ فَارِسَ: a person belonging to the people of Persia
key_terms.سَنَةِ: the date or year in which the transmission occurred

ai.seo_question: Who was the Persian man in the chain whom Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام showed him to?
ai.summary: This report preserves part of a sanad/isnad and a brief statement concerning a named Persian man who was shown the Imam by Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام. Its significance is historical and biographical, as it relates to identifying those connected to seeing him within the transmission record.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad and Al Hassan the two sons of Ali Bin Ibrahim, that they had both been narrated to in the year two hundred and ninety three, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Rahman Al Abady, from Zou Bin Ali Al Ijaly,
(It has been narrated) from a man from the people of Persia whom he named that Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> had shown him<sup>asws</sup> to him’.
en.sarwar: 14. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad and al-Hassan, two sons of Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated to him in the year two hundred seventy nine from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman al-‘Abdi from Daw’ ibn Ali al-‘Ijli from a man from the people of Fars whose name he mentioned
has that abu Muhammad (a.s.) him (the twelfth Imam (a.s.) ) to him.
